critical_code_review_comments: TTS: services/tts_service.py cleanly separates _chunk_text / generate_narration / estimated_cost_cents; each is unit-testable and unit-tested. Good separation of concerns.
Narration router correctly enforces requires_staff on both POST /generate and DELETE /{slide_id}. Learner-blocked test (403) confirms.

Course POST returning 409 on duplicate title uses an application-side pre-check (before the DB UniqueConstraint fires) — good, since 409 is much more meaningful than a raw IntegrityError → 500. The Alembic migration also declares uq_courses_org_title as a defence-in-depth.

SQLite PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON is now in core/database.py (as recommended in iteration_16). Previous flashcard-review cascade issue is resolved — verified because the pytest test_bulk_save_and_learner_review_flow is now green.

Frontend NarrationEditor uses confirm() on delete — mildly heavy UX (browser-native dialog). Consider swapping for the existing sonner toast + inline confirm chip if you want to standardise on non-blocking dialogs. Non-blocking.

LearnPage renders inline <audio> only when slide.narration_url is truthy — clean conditional. Behaviour verified indirectly via pytest (course endpoint returns narration_url after generate + slide.narration_voice='nova').
